name: Zombie, Deer
body:
DEER ZOMBIE
CR 1

XP 400
NE Large undead
Init -1; darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 8, flat-footed 11 (-1 Dex, -1 size, +3 natural)
hp 26 (4d8 + 8)
Fort +1, Ref +0, Will +4
DR 5/slashing; Immune undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft.
Melee gore +4 (1d8+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 9, Con —, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +2; CMB +6; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Toughness
Skills Perception +10
Languages —
SQ single actions only

ABOUT

This rotting stag ambles out from the rain-soaked tree line, its neck torn open with fatal puncture wounds and its dead eyes staring blankly into the storm.

Animated by ambient necromantic energies, it charges blindly into travelers, battering through barricades with its heavy antlers.
